_comment: Tier-2: EQUIVALENT_PLASTIC_STRAIN / PLASTIC_DISSIPATION / UNIAXIAL_STRESS cannot be read off the law object — read them with element.CalculateOnIntegrationPoints(...). Pitfall (kratos.constitutive_laws #8). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The module split the claim states is confirmed exactly: EQUIVALENT_PLASTIC_STRAIN and UNIAXIAL_STRESS are ConstitutiveLawsApplication attributes and not core ones, while PLASTIC_DISSIPATION is a core KratosMultiphysics attribute and not a CLA one. Getting that backwards raises AttributeError before any read is attempted. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
